description: This file defines a PHP class, ViewAssignClaimController, which is part of the OrangeHRM project. It extends a base controller and sets up a Vue component with employee-specific data for claim assignment functionality.

classes.name: ViewAssignClaimController
classes.description: A controller class that manages the view for assigning claims to employees, extending the AbstractVueController and utilizing VueJS components.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering by creating an 'employee-claim' component and setting the employee number property based on authenticated user data.
